cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: Hi Thomas, how are you enjoying the course so far? THOMAS: Yeah, I think it's good.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: JEANNE: Remind me — why did you decide to study sports science?

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: Didn't you want to be a professional athlete when you were at school?

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: Yeah — that was my goal, and all my classmates assumed I would achieve it; they

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: thought I was brilliant. JEANNE: That must have been a nice feeling.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: Mm, I thought I could win anything. There was no one who could run faster than me.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: JEANNE: Exactly — so what happened? Did your mum and dad want you to be more ‘academic’?

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: Not at all. Perhaps they should have pushed me harder, though.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: JEANNE: What do you mean? THOMAS: I think I should have practised more.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: What makes you say that?

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: Well, I went out to Kenya for a couple of weeks to train ... JEANNE: Really!

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: I didn't know that.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: I was chosen to go there out of loads of kids and run with some of the top

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: teenage athletes in the world. And ... I was so calm about it.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: I just kept thinking how fortunate I was. What a great chance this was!

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: Everyone back home was so proud of me.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: But once we started competing, I very quickly realised I wasn’t good enough.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: JEANNE: That must have been a huge shock. THOMAS: I thought ‘this can’t be happening’!

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: I was used to winning.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: 18 1718867188 THOMAS: That's right.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: You can imagine the damage to players’ necks when the ball was headed.

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: JEANNE: How painful that must have been!

cues.speaker: JEANNE
cues.text: THOMAS: Yeah, well, I think we can put together some useful ideas ... Hello everyone.
